notes:
0.12.0.0
- The Brawler is now the Weapons Master. Melee hits land where the blade sweeps; souls cap at 50.
- Toxicologist reworked: it carries the Assault Rifle and a flask key draws the Lobber.
- Skills window: grey until learned, the next level's change in green when you hover the +, and a line per class rule at the top.
- Prestige tree: plaques fit their text, class nodes can be switched on and off, node 23 gives a full Stims and Prototype Shield stack.
- The reload ring now follows the real reload.
- Zombies far away are no longer moved; zombies with no way to you are quietly removed.
- The game now carries its own certificate list, so the update check works on PCs whose Windows lacks it (download this zip once).
